# SenselessProxyMethod

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Unused](/rules/#unused) · PhpStorm name: `SenselessProxyMethodInspection`

An override whose only statement forwards its parameters unchanged to the
same-named parent method — with the same signature, modifiers and
documentation tags — adds nothing; inheritance already provides that
behaviour. Remove it.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{36,41,63} [Before]
<?php
class Store
{
    protected function __construct($cfg = []) {}

    public function put($key, $value = 0) { return true; }

    public function get($key) {}

    public function drop($key) {}

    public function tag($key) {}

    /**
     * @api
     */
    public function flush($all) {}

    public function label($text = __CLASS__) {}

    public function size(): int { return 0; }

    public function keys(array $filter) { return []; }

    public static function make() {}
}

class DiskStore extends Store
{
    public function __construct($cfg = [])
    {
        parent::__construct($cfg);
    }

    /** Disk variant. */
    public function put($k, $v = 0)
    {
        return parent::put($k, $v);
    }

    public function get($key)
    {
        // just delegate
        parent::get($key);
    }

    public function drop($key)
    {
        parent::drop(trim($key));
    }

    /**
     * @internal
     */
    public function tag($key)
    {
        parent::tag($key);
    }

    /**
     * @api
     */
    public function flush($all)
    {
        parent::flush($all);
    }

    public function label($text = __CLASS__)
    {
        parent::label($text);
    }

    public function size(): ?int
    {
        return parent::size();
    }

    public function keys($filter)
    {
        return parent::keys($filter);
    }

    #[Cached]
    public static function make()
    {
        parent::make();
    }
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 36: Method &#39;put&#39; only forwards to its parent; remove it.</li>
<li>line 41: Method &#39;get&#39; only forwards to its parent; remove it.</li>
<li>line 63: Method &#39;flush&#39; only forwards to its parent; remove it.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "SenselessProxyMethod": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore SenselessProxyMethod

/**
 * @noinspection SenselessProxyMethodInspection
 */
```
